visual_reference.reference_title: machi cold brew cafe landing page

layout.concept: Atmospheric sky-blue canvas with high-contrast floating beverage heroes, flowing into pastel-tinted product tiles and an editorial storytelling split banner, grounded by an authoritative ultra-bold wordmark footer.
layout.alignment: Left-aligned editorial typography on wide desktop grid, with centered floating hero focal elements and balanced multi-column product card distribution.

principles: The canteen interface departs from utilitarian gray table layouts by adopting the breezy, sunny aesthetic of modern Japanese-Italian boutique beverage brands (machi). High-contrast dark espresso typography anchors joyful sky-blue atmospheric gradients and delicious soft pastel cards, making school lunch pre-ordering feel delightfully premium and refreshing.

orchestrated_moment.trigger: hero-floating-cups load and gentle continuous vertical-drift parallax
orchestrated_moment.justification: Exactly ONE continuous floating motion moment on the hero beverage cups gives an organic, chilled freshness without inducing cognitive motion fatigue across the rest of the application.

token_overrides.border_radius: rounded-3xl (24px) for cards, rounded-full for pills and action badges
token_overrides.spacing: Generous py-20 to py-28 section gutters, 4/8dp spatial grid inside cards
token_overrides.palette: Custom sky atmosphere (#64B5F6 to #FFFFFF) overriding default dark/gray slate primitives
